summary: 锂辉石精矿除Li2O品位外，铁、钠钾、云母/细粉等杂质也会影响转换厂收率、渣量和可接受性，不能只用SC6标签判断质量。
why_search_may_miss_it: 公开价格方法更关注Li2O品位，完整精矿规格常只在承购/产品技术文件里。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 formalized Li2O grade but not non-lithium quality penalties
recalled_details.schema_implication: concentrate product spec needs impurity/particle dimensions when available

suggested_queries: spodumene concentrate specification iron impurity mica converter
锂辉石 精矿 杂质 铁 云母 规格
disconfirmation_queries: SC6 concentrates interchangeable regardless of impurity profile

summary: 部分包销合同可能含价格floor/cap、基准价折扣或重谈条款，极端高低价周期实际结算未必线性跟随公开现货指数。
why_search_may_miss_it: 具体条款常商业保密，只在融资文件或争议公告中部分披露。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 captured pricing lag/formula but not non-linear contract protections

suggested_queries: spodumene offtake price floor cap renegotiation lithium
锂精矿 包销 价格 下限 上限 重谈
disconfirmation_queries: all spodumene offtake contracts linear to spot/index prices

summary: 澳洲港口天气、热带气旋和铁路/公路中断会让矿山生产与出口装船短期背离，形成区域性的精矿发运波动。
why_search_may_miss_it: 行业月度供给表不一定记录物流中断，矿企季度报告只在事件发生时解释。

recalled_details.gap_reason: inventory/in-transit was covered, but weather-driven export timing was not

suggested_queries: spodumene shipment cyclone port disruption Western Australia lithium
锂精矿 澳大利亚 气旋 港口 发运
disconfirmation_queries: Australian spodumene shipments unaffected by port/weather disruptions

summary: 矿山可能销售低品位精矿、尾矿再处理产品或不同产品blend，同一公司总精矿吨数对应的平均Li2O含量会变化，影响真实LCE供给。
why_search_may_miss_it: 产销公告常汇总吨数，产品品位mix只在运营评论或技术资料。

recalled_details.gap_reason: grade normalization existed per observation, but time-varying mine product mix was not explicit
recalled_details.schema_implication: mine shipment supply should preserve tonnes and contained-Li2O, not tonnes alone

suggested_queries: spodumene low grade concentrate fines product mix lithium mine
锂精矿 低品位 产品结构 精矿 吨数
disconfirmation_queries: all reported concentrate tonnes from a mine have stable Li2O content

summary: 部分锂矿伴生钽等副产品或副产收益可能影响矿山净成本和停产阈值，单一精矿现金成本曲线未必可比。
why_search_may_miss_it: 锂成本表常不给副产品信用，技术/财报资料才显示。

recalled_details.gap_reason: cost semantics covered grade/recovery but not by-product credits

suggested_queries: lithium mine tantalum byproduct credit spodumene cost
锂矿 钽 副产品 成本 抵扣
disconfirmation_queries: lithium mine reported costs never include material by-product credits

summary: 贸易商/中间商在精矿现货市场中的库存融资和转售可能使矿山销售对象与最终转换厂不同，source independence和ownership chain不能只看最终新闻里的买卖双方。
why_search_may_miss_it: 贸易链商业保密，媒体往往只写矿山或最终锂盐厂。

recalled_details.gap_reason: offtake/merchant supply was covered structurally, but intermediary ownership/financing was not

suggested_queries: spodumene trader merchant inventory financing spot cargo China
锂精矿 贸易商 库存 融资 现货 转售
disconfirmation_queries: spodumene cargoes always move directly mine-to-converter
